expression: (() => {const main=document.querySelector('main');if(!main||document.querySelector('.loading-world'))return false;const scenes=[],stores=[];let fiber=main[Object.keys(main).find(k=>k.startsWith('__reactFiber'))];for(;fiber;fiber=fiber.return){for(let h=fiber.memoizedState;h;h=h.next){if(h.memoizedState?.current?.unitMeshes)scenes.push(h.memoizedState);if(h.memoizedState?.getWorld)stores.push(h.memoizedState)}}for(const store of stores){const ref=scenes.find(r=>r.current?.world===store.getWorld());if(!ref?.current?.renderer?.domElement?.isConnected||ref.current.world.outcome.level!==3)continue;window.testSceneRef=ref;window.testScene=ref.current;window.testStore=store;return true}return false})()
